findings.summary: `rules += active_promos(now)` mutates the cached list returned by `load_rules` in place, so promos accumulate in the tenant's cached rules, expired promos persist, discounts compound, and `list_rules_handler` returns promos as tenant rules.
The rules cache is per-process and `save_rules` only invalidates it in the writing process, so other workers serve stale rules indefinitely with no expiry.
No test calls `price_quote` twice with an active promo, so the cache corruption bug goes undetected.
The last `save_rules` call in `test_save_invalidates_cache` has no assertion after it, so it verifies nothing.
